US-Iran Conflict Escalates in Middle East

The conflict between the US and Iran has escalated, with both sides engaging in military strikes against each other's interests. The US has been conducting airstrikes on Iranian targets for the seventh consecutive night, while Iran has targeted Kuwait's desalination plants. This escalation has raised concerns about regional stability and the potential for further conflict.
